messages.author: 9d35f98d2827dff8
messages.subject: Extracting values for factor levels
parts:
Hi, 

I am fairly new to Cardinal and am currently running a supervised workflow with tissue microarray samples with five different subtypes. As a result I have a diagnosis factor with five levels. My question is how do I extract and plot the average spectrum for a single level/subtype? I've included how I create the factor below:

diagnosis <- as.character(rep(NA, ncol(My_data)))

diagnosis[subtype1] <- "subtype1"
diagnosis[subtype2] <- "subtype2"
diagnosis[subtype3] <- "subtype3"
diagnosis[subtype4] <- "subtype4"
diagnosis[subtype5] <- "subtype5"

diagnosis <- as.factor(diagnosis)
pixelData(my_data)$diagnosis <- diagnosis

(I do of course have several pre-defined ROIs included in each diagnosis)

Thanks,
Andreas Abildskov
